## What I did

The `office-templates` skill and its engine (`scripts/gen_doc.py`) were already present in `.zcode/skills/`, so the work was to invoke it per the CLI contract and verify the results. I installed `python-docx` into a venv at `/tmp/ot-venv` (the system Python is PEP 668 externally-managed, so `pip install` was refused), then ran the two commands with exit code 0 each.

Deliverables, exactly two files per unit directory:

```
out/请示函/case2/   文书.docx  fields.json
out/会议通知/case2/ 文书.docx  fields.json
```

## Behavior verified

**请示函 / case2** — filled 4/8, missing_required `[主送机关, 请示事项]`, optional missing `[联系电话, 成文日期]`, no unknown keys. The absent 主送机关 renders as a top-flush salutation `____：`, the empty-string 请示事项 renders as `____`, the contact line keeps its labels (`联系人：李工　　联系电话：`), and 成文日期 leaves an empty-but-present right-aligned second 落款 line, so 落款一 `评测技术部` still holds its row.

**会议通知 / case2** — filled 5/11, missing_required `[会议名称, 会议地点]`, optional missing `[会议议题, 会议要求, 联系人, 联系电话]`, `unknown_keys: ["备注"]`. Title becomes `关于召开____的通知`; the optional 会议要求 list is omitted whole, so no section header appears in the document at all; 会议议题 and both contact fields keep labels with empty values.

Both documents carry the A4 page with GB/T 9704 margins (3.7/3.5/2.8/2.6 cm), centered 黑体 22pt titles, 仿宋 16pt body at 28pt fixed line spacing with `firstLineChars=200` first-line indent, top-flush salutation (no indent set), and right-aligned 落款 with 32pt right indent. Every `missing` entry in both ledgers carries `value: null`, `filled + missing == total` holds, and `summary` and `missing_fields` match the input's missing facts exactly.

## One thing worth flagging

Re-running the same command with the same `--outdir` produces a byte-identical `fields.json` and a docx whose every zip entry payload is byte-identical — but the `.docx` file bytes themselves differ. That is python-docx stamping fresh mtimes into the zip container at save time, not content nondeterminism. The skill's own docstring claims "产物语义逐字节一致", which holds at the XML-payload level; I verified it entry by entry rather than assuming. I did not change the engine, since this is pre-existing behavior outside the brief's scope, and the visible deliverable is unaffected.
